title: Brick Toy
look: Built from glossy plastic bricks: studs on every surface, toy primaries, a studded baseplate, stop-motion.

doc.essence: The character rebuilt from a box of plastic construction bricks and filmed one frame at a time on a baseplate: square-cornered parts, studs catching the light, a printed face.
doc.notIt: Not clay (hard square plastic with studs, no thumbprints), not pixel (studs and gloss, no pixel filter), not bauhaus (toy palette, studs, a baseplate).
doc.shapes: Nearly square corners, thick even limbs, round knob hands and block feet. A thin darker mould line at every edge.
doc.colour: Areas snap to the toy colours: red, yellow, blue, green, orange, azure, lime, tan, white or black. Every area is covered in studs with a highlight on top.
doc.eyes: Small printed black dots and a thin printed smile.
doc.motion: Stop-motion at 12 fps, like a brick film.
pitfalls: Studs behind the face compete with the printed eyes: the stud shading stays subtle.
Dark bricks swallow dark printed eyes: light eyes stay light.
